leadText: Crimson City (Japanese: ジョウチャンタウン Jōchan Town) is an -exclusive location believed to be in Kanto. It has not been visited by and , but is mentioned in The Fourth Round Rumble at Indigo Plateau. Jeanette Fisher, who battled Ash on the Grass Field, comes from Crimson City.
